description: Portal for Project Atlas retail customers in Lisbon and Porto.
readme_text:
# atlas-customer-portal

Self-service portal for **Project Atlas** retail customers. Owner: **Daniel Okafor** (sales).

Customers will be able to book pickups, see delivery history, and download monthly invoices. The first five soft-launch customers will test it in March 2027 before it opens to all regional retailers.
